extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: electric locomotive with two cabs, 19.0 m over buffers, 2.95 m wide, 4.6 m high with lowered pantographs, standard gauge 1435 mm
extras.notes: front faces -Y, origin on the rail top (wheel contact plane); buffer and coupling axis 1.05 m above rail top (Cozy Trains kit standard); both scissor pantographs are modelled lowered, resting on the roof; bogies with wheelsets are part of the mesh (no moving parts); emissive head and tail lights, opaque tinted windows, no interior, no lettering

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
